snippet.title: Tideborne Haven - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
LAST CHANCE TO SUPPORT ON KICKSTARTER: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tidebornehaven/tideborne-haven-a-cozy-farming-sim-about-saving-the-ocean

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4328840/Tideborne_Haven/

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/tideborne_haven?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/p/Tideborne-Haven-61584475696429/

Discord: 
https://discord.gg/maU7UZGMfT

Tideborne Haven is a cozy, story-driven pixel art life sim set on a fragile tropical island on the brink of collapse.

You arrive by boat to polluted shores, dying reefs, a struggling rainforest, and a community barely holding it together.

As the islands newest caretaker, you’ll restore what’s been lost - cleaning beaches, farming coral, removing invasive species, rebuilding the town, rehabilitating wildlife, and bringing the ecosystem back to life.

Above water, Tideborne Haven plays like a classic life sim. Build relationships, earn trust, unlock upgrades, and help rebuild a run-down island community - while planting mangroves, reviving rainforest habitats, and supporting pollination.

Below the surface, a different world unfolds. Dive into coral reefs, kelp forests, shipwrecks, and ancient ruins - managing oxygen and environmental risks as you uncover rare species, lost relics, and hidden storylines.

Restore a Living Ecosystem
Clean beaches, revive coral reefs, replant mangroves, and restore rainforest habitats, every action directly impacts the islands future.

Dive into a Hidden World
Explore reefs, kelp forests, shipwrecks, and ancient ruins while managing oxygen, hazards, and changing conditions.

Hands-On Coral Restoration
Rescue, grow, and cultivate coral using interactive systems, balance water chemistry, repair tanks, and develop resilient traits.

Rebuild the Island Community
Repair buildings, unlock upgrades, and help bring a struggling town back to life.

Meaningful Wildlife Rescue
Treat injured animals and release them back into the wild to improve your biodiversity score.

Shape the Balance of Nature
Breed and release fish to control algae, pests, and even other fish (determined to eat your hard work).

Deep Relationships & Hidden Motives
Build friendships, rivalries, and romance while uncovering which islander is secretly exploiting the island.

Dynamic World Systems
Experience shifting weather, tides, seasons, and events that impact both land and ocean gameplay.

Uncover Ancient Mysteries
Restore a museum, collect relics, and explore forgotten lore tied to mermaid legends and the island’s past.

A World That Changes With You
Watch the island evolve from polluted and broken to vibrant and thriving based on your choices.
